name: Yahiro Kasumi
source:
The protagonist's friend and classmate, she supports her from the shadows.
A kind and gentle girl, she often goes along with what the protagonist does and doesn't act on her own much.
A sort of weak girl who always asks the protagonist first before deciding something, but if she has an opposite opinion she can be surprisingly stubborn.
